item.title: What's that haze in the air in Gothenburg?
item.description: Swedish newspapers are reporting that for three days there's been a thick layer of smog covering the west coast city of Gothenburg.

item.title: Unemployment falls in Sweden, but no one knows what the future holds
item.description: Unemployment is at the lowest level since the end of 2023, but layoff notices are on the increase and the war in Iran could put another damper on things.

item.title: NEW: The Local's self-paced Swedish course
item.description: Due to popular demand The Local's self-paced online Swedish course for beginners is back, designed to make learning flexible and practical.

item.title: The most unexpected foreign words in Swedish
item.description: Every language borrows from its neighbours: English is a proper mongrel, with layers of German, Danish and Norman French interspersed with smatterings of Celtic. Swedish has borrowed liberally from German, French and English, but a few other languages have left their mark, often in a way that tells a story about Swedish history. Here are some of the best.

item.title: 'I chose my mental health': Indian entrepreneur leaves Sweden after deportation order
item.description: Abhijith Nag Balasubramanya's circular-system hydroponics startup was already providing locally-grown produce to a major grocery store in Skellefteå, northern Sweden, when his business visa was denied by the Swedish Migration Agency. He has now left Sweden.

item.title: How to join a protest about immigration laws in Sweden this weekend
item.description: Demonstrations are planned in nearly 30 different locations across Sweden on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday (just Stockholm for that last one). Here's how you can join.

item.title: No transitional rules for Swedish citizenship in proposed law
item.description: The Swedish government has posted the proposed text of a new law changing the rules for citizenship, set to come into force on June 6th ‒ and there are no transitional rules, meaning that people who apply before then could be assessed under the new requirements.

item.title: Author of Swedish 'death cleaning' bestseller dies age 92
item.description: Author Margareta Magnusson, who wrote a 2017 bestseller about "Swedish death cleaning" before one's passing to spare loved ones the task, has died age 92.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Friday
item.description: No transitional rules for Swedish citizenship in proposed law, Liberals may soften on Sweden Democrats, Swedes drank less alcohol last year and more news from Sweden on Friday.

item.title: Join our LIVE reader's Q&A on Sweden's tightening of citizenship rules
item.description: Join our Live Q&A with our team at the The Local Sweden on Friday as we respond to your comments and questions on Sweden's controversial citizenship changes, set to come into force in June.
